policy: Individual peer-reviewed fits for bundled white dwarfs without an uncontaminated O'Brien et al. (2024) Table A1 fit. Values are read from the cited table; quantities that depend on an assumed surface gravity are not adopted.

cns5-0544.section: Farihi et al. (2013) Table 3 and section 3.1

temperature_k.method: Weighted mean of DQ model-atmosphere fits to HST/WFC3 photometry (8210 +/- 180 K) and the HST/STIS G430L spectrum (8145 +/- 180 K)
temperature_k.caveat: F225W and F275W are excluded because the models over-predict C I absorption there; including them gives 8420 +/- 90 K (section 3.1).

mass_solar.method: Radius from the fitted solid angle and the Hipparcos parallax, converted with the Fontaine et al. (2001) mass-radius relation
mass_solar.caveat: Independent dynamical masses: 0.595 +/- 0.010 (Brandt, Dupuy & Bowler 2019, AJ 158, 140, Table 6) agrees; 0.5425 +/- 0.0042 (Zeng et al. 2022, AJ 164, 188, Table 3) differs by about 5 sigma. Neither replaces the atmospheric value here.

radius_solar.method: Fitted solid angle and Hipparcos parallax (92.74 mas)
radius_solar.caveat: The uncertainty is retained as printed; it is about ten times wider than the quoted mass and log g errors imply.

cns5-0544.note: Farihi et al. (2013) DQ6 fit of HST photometry and STIS spectroscopy: Teff 8180 +/- 120 K, log g 8.02 +/- 0.02, mass 0.59 +/- 0.01 solar masses, radius 0.01245 solar radii; luminosity from radius and Teff. Brandt et al. (2019) find a consistent dynamical mass of 0.595 +/- 0.010; Zeng et al. (2022) find 0.5425 +/- 0.0042. The 1.25 Gyr cooling age is not adopted as total age.

hip-45336-component-b.withheld: Detected only in EUV/UV as an unresolved companion of a B9.5V star. Burleigh & Barstow (1999, A&A 341, 795, Table 3) fit Teff 25,800-30,800 K for assumed log g 7.5-9.0, and Vennes et al. (1998, ApJ 502, 763) 28,700-32,700 K for an assumed log g 9.0. No surface gravity, mass or radius has been measured. Holberg et al. (2013, MNRAS 435, 2077, Tables 1-2) list 30,700 K and 1.21 solar masses without uncertainties or a stated source; these match an assumed log g of about 9. No value that depends on an assumed gravity is adopted.
